desc: Define the four diagonal directions as (dx, dy) pairs and the clockwise mapping between them.

Precompute `dp[i][j][dir]` = length of valid alternating sequence starting at cell (i,j) with value 1 and moving in direction `dir` (including the starting cell). Use DP from the opposite end of the direction so each cell depends on the next cell.

For each cell, evaluate straight segments (just `dp[i][j][dir]`) and V-shaped segments by combining two legs with a clockwise turn, taking `dp[d1][i][j] + dp[d2][i][j] - 1` where `d2` is the clockwise successor of `d1`.
Track the maximum length across all possibilities and return it.
Write the final `lenOfVDiagonal` method inside the `Solution` class, ensuring O(n·m) time and O(n·m) memory.
Test with the provided examples to verify correctness.
Handle edge cases like 1x1 grid with value 1.
Verify that the alternating pattern is correctly enforced (only checking for 2 at the first step after 1, since the DP ensures subsequent steps follow the pattern).
